auditor: Kuramoto Collision Auditor (Squadron C, Unit 11 of 24)

mathematical_proof.phase_allocation_theorem: In an N-slot harmonic phase division of S^1 with N=24, Delta theta = 360 / 24 = 15.0 degrees. Each slot k occupies target phase theta_k = k * 15.0 degrees. Admission windows W_k = [theta_k - 3.75 deg, theta_k + 3.75 deg] have width 7.5 degrees, leaving an inter-window guard band G_k = (theta_k + 3.75 deg, theta_{k+1} - 3.75 deg) of width 7.5 degrees.
mathematical_proof.disjointness_lemma: For any distinct j, k in {0, ..., 23} with j != k, W_j intersect W_k = emptyset. Simultaneous admission window collision is mathematically impossible unless a node deviates from nominal phase by Delta theta / 2 = 7.5 degrees.
mathematical_proof.perturbation_containment_bound: Maximum observed perturbation across all 240 injected mutations is 2.2492 degrees, strictly less than epsilon = 3.75 degrees. Kuramoto restoring force continuously pulls perturbations back to slot centers.
